key_insight: A visual analytics framework links evolving cancer care team collaboration patterns with model-estimated patient outcome risk, without implying causation.
clinical_relevance: The system may help analysts examine how care team composition and specialist participation relate to estimated risk across cancer treatment stages.
method: Build dynamic care team networks from EHR-mediated communications.
Estimate risk over time using a temporal graph neural network.
Explore network views, surrogate logistic regression explanations, and what-if analyses.
evidence_signal: Expert-guided analysis scenarios involved 505 patients with breast, colorectal, and lung cancers; the abstract reports no quantitative predictive performance metrics.
watch_item: Observed associations and exploratory what-if results do not establish that changing care team composition improves outcomes.
paper_title: Visualizing and Interpreting Temporal Care Team Dynamics for Cancer Survival Risk Analysis
